message.content:
一顆普通中等大小的番茄（約 123 g）大約含有 **22 卡路里**。  
如果你想知道不同大小的番茄大概熱量，參考以下範例：

| 大小 | 重量 (g) | 熱量 (卡) |
|------|----------|-----------|
| 小番茄 | 約 90 | 約 15 |
| 中等番茄 | 約 123 | 約 22 |
| 大番茄 | 約 180 | 約 30 |

這些數值是根據番茄平均營養成分（每 100 g 約 18–20 卡）估算的，實際熱量會因品種、成熟度和種植環境略有差異。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "一個番茄有多少卡路里？" (How many calories in one tomato?). They want the calorie content of a tomato. We can provide approximate value: about 22 calories per 100g, but per one tomato depends on size. A medium tomato (~123g) has about 22 calories. But the user might want a specific number. We can give typical values: 18-22 calories per medium tomato. We can also mention that a small tomato (~90g) has ~15 calories, large (~180g) ~30 calories. Provide approximate. No function call needed.
